# ledger_bank_applications (Data Source)

Lists the banking-data provider applications Ledger is configured with, with each one's mode, environment, account access and capabilities. Credentials are never shown, and Terraform cannot configure an application. Read only, and needs an API token with the `connections:read` grant. The values are bank-sourced facts as Ledger reports them: they are never edited here, and they are kept apart from your own corrections. Reading changes nothing at the bank, and no consent is started, completed or refreshed (connecting a bank needs you at the bank's own page, in Ledger's UI). Account numbers, balances, provider session references and credentials are never read into Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The provider applications Ledger is configured with (credentials are never shown).
data "ledger_bank_applications" "all" {}

output "bank_applications" {
  value = [for a in data.ledger_bank_applications.all.items : "${a.name}: mode ${a.mode}, ${a.environment}, access ${a.account_access}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The applications. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `account_access` (String) `all` reaches every account the person consents to; `linked_only` (developer mode) only accounts linked to the application at the provider.
- `capabilities` (Attributes) What the application can do. A number of zero means not known, never none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--capabilities))
- `environment` (String) `production` or `sandbox`.
- `mode` (String) The provider's own mode terminology, `app` or `developer`. It is neither production nor sandbox.
- `name` (String) The operator's name for the application; connections record it.
- `provider_name` (String) The banking-data provider, for example `enable_banking`.

<a id="nestedatt--items--capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.capabilities`

Read-Only:

- `background_fetches_per_day` (Number) How many background fetches per day the provider allows, or 0 when not known.
- `balance_types` (List of String) The balance types the provider can report: `booked`, `available`, `expected` or `other`.
- `max_consent_validity_days` (Number) The longest consent validity in days, or 0 when not known.
- `max_history_days` (Number) How many days of history can be fetched, or 0 when not known.
- `pending_transactions` (Boolean) Whether pending transactions are available.
